newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine GDP up 6.6 pct in Q3 - official.
newsitem.headline: Argentine GDP up 6.6 pct in Q3 - official.

text.p: Argentina's gross domestic product grew by 6.6 percent in the third quarter compared with the same period last year, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.
The ministry said gross fixed investment expanded by 17 percent in the period compared with the third quarter 1995.
The ministry said in a statement that bank loans were up by 9.1 percent in October compared to the same month last year. Bank deposits jumped by 18.6 percent during the period.
Sales of goods covered by value-added tax rose by 19.6 percent in August compared to the same month last year.
Exports rose by 10.0 percent in the first nine months of the year and imports by 15.0 percent. Imports of capital goods increased by 13.7 percent in September, compared with September last year.
Industrial production rose by 11.1 percent in September compared with the same mointh last year and services output by 11.9 percent.
Economists surveyed by Reuters RPLATQ RPLATR had made an average forecast of 5.4-percent GPD growth in the third quarter. The median forecast was for 6.0-percent growth.
